title: Spawn Rate and Map Capacity
intro: How MapleStory Classic mobs respawn: 7.56s server tick, 5s per-point cooldown, and the player-count scaling that decides how many mobs fill a map.

blocks.p: [[img:fc8a87617e5660.png]] Our spawn model uses three rules: a global server tick, a per-spawn-point cooldown, and a map capacity that changes with player count. The exact player-count curve still needs direct confirmation in current live play.

The server runs one respawn check every **7.56 seconds**, globally. That pass walks every loaded map and asks each empty spawn point whether it is ready to refill. The tick is a **synchronization gate**: a mob whose cooldown ended 1 second ago still has to wait for the next tick before it appears. Think of it as a bus that stops every 7.56s; mobs queue up between buses and all board at once.
When many mobs die in a short window (an AoE clear), they all respawn at the next tick together. The map looks empty for a few seconds, then refills in one wave.
Each spawn point has its own post-death cooldown that runs in parallel with the global tick. The cooldown depends on whether the spawn is wave-pool or timed:

table: Timed spawn (the point has its own timer)

blocks.p: Effective respawn = the **first 7.56s tick at or after (death + cooldown)**. Wave cooldowns are shorter than the tick, so a freshly-cleared wave point cycles roughly every 7.56s in active grinding. A timed boss on a 300s timer cycles in 300s plus up to 7.56s of tick slop, so closer to 304s on average.

blocks.h2: Map capacity scales with player count

blocks.p: The model sets maximum concurrent mobs to **map spawn points multiplied by a player-count scalar**: 75% for one player, then +5% per extra player, up to 100% at six. This curve powers the map calculators, but every live player-count step has not been measured yet.

For a wave-pool spawn point that always has someone clearing it, the upper ceiling is **3600 / 7.56 ≈ 476 spawns per hour**. Apply the player-count scalar above: ~357/hr solo, ~476/hr in a full party. For a timed spawn on a 60-second timer, the per-point rate is **3600 / (60 + ~3.78) ≈ 56 spawns per hour**; the tick adds an average half-tick (~3.78s) of slop on every cycle. The player-count scalar does not apply to timed spawns.

Each map's data carries a spawn-rate multiplier, typically between 0.8 and 2.0. Other MapleStory servers multiplied map capacity by it. **MSC does not.** The live game ignores it; capacity comes only from spawn-point count and the player scalar.

**Solo grinders:** the best grind maps guide already uses the 75% solo baseline. Do not reduce those listed ceilings again.
**Party grinders:** the model gives a full six-player map about 33% more spawn capacity than a solo map, before the EXP party bonus.
**Timed bosses ignore player count.** The current map record gives Mushmom a 60-minute base timer. Two independent in-game reports put its return near 90 minutes, so use an unconfirmed 60 to 90 minute window.

Still unverified in current live play: whether the player-count curve is exactly linear at every step, whether timed spawn points sit outside the wave-pool cap, and whether the 7.56-second tick can slip under load. Until those checks are complete, the calculator is for comparisons only.
Special thanks to Cody (OSMS) for documenting the spawn system used as the model's starting point.
